candidates.label: Self-prohibition of the lawful for spousal approval corrected under forgiveness
candidates.definition: In 66:1: O Prophet why do you prohibit yourself from what Allah has made lawful for you seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ لَكَۖ تَبۡتَغِي مَرۡضَاتَ أَزۡوَٰجِكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Oath-dissolution ordained as legal relief under divine knowledge and wisdom
candidates.definition: In 66:2: Allah has already ordained for you the dissolution of your oaths; and Allah is your protector and He is the Knowing the Wise.

evidence.excerpt: قَدۡ فَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡ تَحِلَّةَ أَيۡمَٰنِكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ مَوۡلَىٰكُمۡۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Confidential disclosure breached and divinely revealed with partial confrontation
candidates.definition: In 66:3: And when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement and when she informed another of it and Allah showed it to him he made known part of it and ignored a part; and when he informed her about it she said who told you this; he said I was informed by the Knowing the Acquainted.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضِ أَزۡوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثٗا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتۡ بِهِۦ وَأَظۡهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِ عَرَّفَ بَعۡضَهُۥ وَأَعۡرَضَ عَنۢ بَعۡضٖۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتۡ مَنۡ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَاۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ ٱلۡخَبِيرُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Domestic opposition met by divine-angelic-believer protection network
candidates.definition: In 66:4: If you two repent to Allah it is best for your hearts have deviated; but if you cooperate against him then indeed Allah is his protector and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels moreover are his assistants.

evidence.excerpt: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ صَغَتۡ قُلُوبُكُمَاۖ وَإِن تَظَٰهَرَا عَلَيۡهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ مَوۡلَىٰهُ وَجِبۡرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Family protection from Fire fuelled by people and stones as believer duty
candidates.definition: In 66:6: O you who have believed protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones over which are angels harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ وَأَهۡلِيكُمۡ نَارٗا وَقُودُهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱلۡحِجَارَةُ عَلَيۡهَا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَاظٞ شِدَادٞ لَّا يَعۡصُونَ ٱللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُونَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Sincere repentance removing misdeeds with light perfected on the Day of non-disgrace
candidates.definition: In 66:8: O you who have believed repent to Allah with sincere repentance; perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow on the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him; their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say our Lord perfect for us our light and forgive us indeed You are over all things competent.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوۡبَةٗ نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمۡ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلَكُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ يَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّبِيَّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥۖ نُورُهُمۡ يَسۡعَىٰ بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَبِأَيۡمَٰنِهِمۡ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتۡمِمۡ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Two disbelieving wives under righteous prophets availing nothing against Allah
candidates.definition: In 66:10: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot; they were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all and it was said enter the Fire with those who enter.

evidence.excerpt: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ نُوحٖ وَٱمۡرَأَتَ لُوطٖۖ كَانَتَا تَحۡتَ عَبۡدَيۡنِ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيۡنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمۡ يُغۡنِيَا عَنۡهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا وَقِيلَ ٱدۡخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّـٰخِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Pharaoh's wife and Mary as believing-women exempla across tyranny and chastity
candidates.definition: In 66:11-12: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh when she said my Lord build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people; and Mary the daughter of Imran who guarded her chastity so We blew into her garment through Our angel and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

evidence.excerpt: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلٗا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱمۡرَأَتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِذۡ قَالَتۡ رَبِّ ٱبۡنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيۡتٗا فِي ٱلۡجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَرۡيَمَ ٱبۡنَتَ عِمۡرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَحۡصَنَتۡ فَرۡجَهَا فَنَفَخۡنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتۡ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
